stacks.name: Optimisation
stacks.description: Core update rules and loss behaviour.

cards.front: What is the gradient descent update rule?
What does the learning rate \(\eta\) control?
cards.back: It controls the step size taken in the direction of the negative gradient.

cards.front: When can gradient descent overshoot a minimum?
cards.back: When \(\eta\) is too large, updates can jump past the low-loss region and diverge.

cards.front: State the normal equation for linear regression.
cards.back: For design matrix \(X\) and target vector \(y\), \[\hat\beta = (X^T X)^{-1}X^T y.\]

cards.front: What is the prediction rule for linear regression?

stacks.name: Kernel Basics
stacks.description: Feature maps, similarities, and kernel notation.

cards.back: A kernel is a function \(K(x,y)\) such that \[K(x,y)=\langle \phi(x), \phi(y) \rangle\] for some feature map \(\phi\).
It computes inner products in a feature space using \(K(x,y)\), without explicitly forming \(\phi(x)\).
